label: TP
reason: User-supplied values from request parameters (via getValue and getName) directly concatenate into the response output stream via string concatenation (+), which serves as an XSS sink. The sanitization chain (base64 encode/decode, substring, split) operates on a different variable (g5528 initialized with a hardcoded literal) and does not affect the flow of the actual user input reaching the sink.

evidence.note: User input from request parameters flows directly into response.getWriter().println() via string concatenation without effective neutralization.
